scope: API20 SDK declarations and official OpenHarmony6.0 framework source used to interpret callbacks on the tested OpenHarmony6.1.0.31 image. Source ordering is not a physical display measurement.
idleFinding: FrameCallback.onIdle can be deferred beyond the updated frame. TriggerIdleCallback keeps callbacks pending and requests another frame when the remaining idle budget is insufficient. OnIdle also returns during window animation. Intent-to-onIdle is an idle-readiness metric, not same-frame rendering latency.
drawFinding: FlushVsync calls frame callbacks, flushes building and layout, emits didLayout, then flushes render messages before HandleDrawCommandSendCallBack. The public willDraw observer identifies the draw-command boundary, not physical display scanout.
instrumentation: Measurement is disabled in ordinary use. Native tests enable it, capture first onFrame, didLayout, willDraw and eventual onIdle timestamps after a Library open, compare the complete restored checkpoint, and independently verify the native Resume heading. Raw idle diagnostics remain separate from the draw-command measurement.
